title: Hosts
description: Machines that run Manar components, the install keys that enrol them, and the rules that approve them.
accessDeniedBody: Hosts are visible to Tenant Owners, Security Admins and Auditors.
readOnlyNote: Read-only: your role can view hosts but not change them.
selfReported: Key type and hostname are reported by the machine itself. Manar does not verify them with hardware attestation yet, so treat the install key as the control and these as filters.

hosts.softwareKeyHint: Reported as a software key, not hardware-backed. Reported by the machine, not verified.

rekey.otherGroup: Also asks to move to another group.

confirm.approveBody: The host can then receive and renew its certificate.
confirm.approveRekeyBody: Binds the requested key and revokes the certificates of the current key. Only the key shown below is approved.
confirm.rejectBody: The host gets no certificate. You can approve it later.
confirm.rejectRekeyBody: Drops the request. The host keeps its current key.
confirm.revokeBody: For a lost or stolen device. Its AI tools stay blocked, and the secrets in Manar’s vault on it are deleted when it next connects: rotate those keys. It can’t register again with the same machine ID. To give a device back to its person, use Remove instead.
confirm.removeBody: It loses access right away. On its next check-in Manar stops protecting it and gives its tools their network back; Manar stays installed until someone uninstalls it. Its history stays under Removed devices, and you can enrol it again within 30 days.
confirm.removed: {hostname} was removed. Its history is under Removed devices.
confirm.removeFailed: {hostname} was not removed. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, contact support.

hosts.reenrolHint: Within 30 days of removal, the device's owner can run the install command on it again: it comes back with its history and waits for approval.
hosts.cloneHint: This machine is already enrolled with another device key. Approve it only if it is a re-install or a copy you expect; the other device keeps working either way.
hosts.unassignedHint: The person who used this device deleted their account. It stays protected; its approvals go to approvers.

installKeys.revokeBody: No machine can register with this key afterwards. Hosts already registered keep their approval.

form.title: Create install key
form.description: An install key registers machines into one host group and grants nothing else.
form.label: Label
form.rangesHint: One per line, for example 10.0.0.0/8. Leave empty for any address.
form.limitsHint: Keys expire in 24 hours and work once unless you choose otherwise. A key can live up to 30 days, or 365 days when it is locked to address ranges.

shown.title: Copy your install key now
shown.warning: You won't see this key again. Store it somewhere safe; if you lose it, revoke it and create another.

rules.empty: No approval rules. Every new host waits for a person.
rules.description: A new machine is approved automatically when every condition set on a rule matches. Otherwise it waits for a person.

form.title: Approval rule
form.patternHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore, plus * and ? (at most three *). Leave empty for any hostname.
form.rangesHint: One per line. Leave empty for any address.

changes.title: AI file changes
changes.description: Files an AI tool changed outside its project folder on a device. The device saved each file first and keeps the copy for 7 days. The copy stays on the device and is never uploaded.
changes.empty: No saved changes for this device in the last 7 days.
changes.windowsNote: A Windows device cannot restore from here. On that device run: manar-edge undo restore

confirm.title: Put this file back?
confirm.bodyChanged: {path} goes back to how it was before the AI tool changed it. The device does this at its next check-in, within about a minute.
confirm.bodyCreated: The AI tool created {path}. Restoring deletes it. The device does this at its next check-in, within about a minute.

kind.settings_write: An AI tool tried to change a hook or settings file. Manar blocked it.
kind.hook_removed: Manar's check was taken out of an AI tool's settings on this device. Manar put it back.
kind.hooks_disabled: A project's Claude Code settings switch off all hooks, so Manar does not check Claude Code in that project.
kind.settings_flag: Claude Code was started with --settings, which can leave Manar's check out.
kind.config_dir: Claude Code ran with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which can leave Manar's check out.
kind.unknown: The device reported that something switched off Manar's checks.
